title: Community Thanksgiving Dinner
seo_title: Community Thanksgiving Dinner in Joplin, MO – Nov 22
description: This is a community Thanksgiving dinner at God's Resort, where you share a meal, catch up with neighbors, and give thanks for ways God has been at work in the community this year. Families are invited to attend and to bring a friend, and people who want to serve can email the organizers. It takes place on November 22, 2026 (time TBD) at 1501 S Pearl Ave in Joplin, Missouri.
